journey.name: Set up
journey.description: Set up asks four things (what else you train, on which days, which bells you own, how long a session is), shows the week they come to, and builds it: the sport on its days, a program one bell and the time are enough for on the days between, the bells and a goal. A fresh install opens on it, once; after that Today's card offers it while nothing is planned, and Settings always has it, where it shows what stands and builds again without starting the program over. Run on a fresh install (adb shell pm clear dev.justinsmith.interval), on a Thursday or with the days below moved to suit.

actions.action: Open the app and verify that it opens on "Set up", with Back in its title bar

Verify that "Set up" asks "What else do you train?", "Which bells do you own, in kg?" and "How long is a session?" with "15 min" picked, that "Your week" says "Answer above and your week shows here.", and that "Build my week" is dimmed
Tap "BJJ" and verify that "On which days?" appears under it with M T W T F S S, none picked, and that "Your week" says "BJJ" over "Pick its days"
Tap M, W and F; tap "16"; leave "15 min"
Verify that "Your week" reads "BJJ" over "Mon, Wed, Fri", "Your first 100 swings" over "about 15 min · Tue, Thu, Sat" and "Goal: 6 workouts a week", with "Pick another program" under the card
Tap "Just the bell" and verify that the days go and the week is the program alone on Mon, Wed, Fri; tap "BJJ" again and verify that M, W and F are still picked
Tap "30 min" and verify that the program becomes "Round conditioning" on two days; tap "15 min" again

Verify that Today is shown with the notice "Week built", the week strip naming "BJJ" under Monday, Wednesday and Friday, "15 min" picked under "Or pick by time", and (on a Tuesday, Thursday or Saturday) "Your first 100 swings" up next with "about 15 min" and "Start day 1"
Tap the "Train" tab, then "Your equipment" on Strength, and verify that 16 kg alone is picked; go back
Open Settings from the gear and verify that the Plan group reads "Weekly goal" 6 with a "Set up" row under "Reminder"
Tap "Set up" and verify that it opens on BJJ with M, W and F picked, 16 ticked and "15 min", and that the week says "Your first 100 swings" over "You follow it already · Tue, Thu, Sat"
Tap T (Tuesday) and "24", and verify that the program's days move to suit and the goal reads 6 still
Tap "Build my week" and verify that Today is shown with "Week built" and "BJJ" under four days of the week

Tap the "Log" tab, then "Edit plan" or the plan's row, and verify that the plan lists BJJ on four days and the program's day on two, each once, and that the program on Train is still on day 1 of the same week it started
Open Settings, tap "Set up", then "Skip for now", and verify that Settings is shown again with nothing changed
Close the app from Recents and open it from its icon; verify that it opens on Today, not on "Set up"

Clear the app (adb shell pm clear dev.justinsmith.interval), open it and verify "Set up" again; tap "Skip for now" and verify that Today says "Nothing planned" with "Set up your week" first; close and open the app again and verify that it opens on Today
